gaps.valueSet: Four-fold or greater Brucella IgG/total-antibody titer increase between paired specimens collected 14-180 days apart
gaps.reason: the source marks rule 4 inoperable; SEM_V1 cannot compare paired specimens, collection intervals, or results across eICRs, so the rule is omitted
the source marks rule 5 inoperable because eICR titer formatting cannot be evaluated; SEM_V1 has no numeric or titer-result comparison predicate, so the rule is omitted

gaps.valueSet: Brucella IgG ELISA collected at least two weeks after symptom onset and numeric result greater than 1.09
gaps.reason: SEM_V1 has no symptom-onset-relative timing or numeric laboratory comparison predicate; BRU-R6 and BRU-R11 retain the source's explicitly partial implementation without timeframe, and BRU-R6 retains coded/abnormal result alternatives

gaps.valueSet: Fever plus at least two compatible clinical finding groups plus a qualifying Brucella epidemiologic exposure
gaps.reason: the source marks rule 7 inoperable because epidemiologic criteria cannot be implemented; the entire rule is omitted to prevent clinical findings alone from overtriggering

gaps.valueSet: Brucellosis culture test panel and Brucellosis IgG ELISA test panel
